seo.title: Sphera Live — Real-Time Multiplayer Quiz · CampusSphere
seo.description: Turn any course or topic into a live multiplayer quiz. Join with a PIN code on your smartphone, compete with classmates, and top the leaderboard.

hero.subtitle: Whether reviewing for an exam in a lecture hall or hosting a trivia session with friends: start your game in 30 seconds, share the PIN, and play in real time.

mockup.sampleQuestion: In which year was the first GPT language model released by OpenAI?
mockup.tryHint: Click an option to test the buzzer
mockup.correctFeedback: Correct! + 1,240 pts added to the leaderboard.
mockup.wrongFeedback: Not quite — the correct answer was 2018 (GPT-1).

ways.title: 3 simple ways to create a game
ways.subtitle: Prepare your quiz in seconds however you prefer.

way1.title: Generate with AI
way1.description: Drop your lecture notes (PDF, Word, TXT) or paste a CampusSphere resource URL. AI extracts key concepts and builds the quiz instantly.
way1.tag: PDF up to 50 MB & direct links

way2.title: Manual creation
way2.description: Keep full control: write each question, 4 choices, set the right answer, and tune the timer (10 to 60s) to fit difficulty.

way3.title: JSON import
way3.description: Import a structured JSON file. Sphera populates the visual editor immediately so you can preview and tweak every question before launch.

universes.title: Two universes, the same adrenaline
universes.subtitle: Sphera Live adapts equally well to university exams and weekend game nights.

study.title: Active Recall gone multiplayer
study.description: Timed recall in a social group dramatically boosts long-term retention compared to passive rereading.
study.item1: Ideal for tutorials, lecture halls, and library study groups
study.item2: Spot concepts misunderstood across the class immediately
study.item3: Realistic training under exam countdown pressure

fun.title: Group trivia on the big screen
fun.description: Ten minutes between classes or a night with friends? Launch a challenge on football, anime, cinema, or general trivia.
fun.item1: Cinema, music, sports, geography, and pop culture
fun.item2: Everyone plays right from their smartphone
fun.item3: Live rankings and animated podium at the end

features.title: Built for a seamless match
features.subtitle: Every detail is tuned for effortless hosting and instant player responsiveness.
features.f1Desc: A 6-letter PIN and your connected account are all you need to enter the room.
features.f2Desc: Immersive audio for ticking timer suspense, with a one-click mute button for classrooms.
features.f3Desc: Celebrate the top 3 players at match end with an animated podium.
features.f4Desc: A precise scoring engine that rewards both speed and accuracy.
features.f5Desc: Rerun the same session with a new group in one click without re-entering questions.
features.f6Desc: Turn any lecture into a competitive quiz in seconds with the Sphera AI engine.

finalCta.title: Ready for the buzzer?
finalCta.subtitle: Create your first Sphera Live session in 30 seconds or join your peers with their PIN code.
